_national.labelling: Geographical indications are registered by INPI under the Industrial Property Law (Lei 9.279/1996) in two kinds: Indicacao de Procedencia (IP), based on reputation, and Denominacao de Origem (DO), based on qualities due to the place. Each GI has its own technical specification (caderno de especificacoes tecnicas) enforced by a producers' regulatory council. Wine DOs: Vale dos Vinhedos (2012) and Altos de Pinto Bandeira (2022, sparkling only); the other wine GIs are IPs.

br-altos-de-pinto-bandeira.varieties: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Riesling Italico only; Riesling Italico base wine at most 25% of a blend.
br-altos-de-pinto-bandeira.max_yield: 12 t/ha (up to 20% more by council decision in a given year); whole bunches pressed, at most 65 l of must per 100 kg of grapes.
br-altos-de-pinto-bandeira.ageing: Traditional method only (no Charmat); at least 12 months from tirage to disgorgement. Base wines up to five years old may be used.
br-altos-de-pinto-bandeira.styles: Sparkling (espumante natural) only: Nature, Extra-Brut, Brut, Sec, Demi-Sec. Council quality qualifiers: Reserva (at least 24 months in bottle), Gran Reserva (36 months), Millesime (vintage, 85% of that harvest, at Reserva or Gran Reserva level).
br-altos-de-pinto-bandeira.labelling: DO granted by INPI on 29 Nov 2022, Brazil's first DO for sparkling wine; 65 km2 at 520 to 770 m, mostly in Pinto Bandeira (with parts of Farroupilha and Bento Goncalves). 100% local grapes; all winemaking inside the area; espaldeira or Y trellis; no machine harvesting.

br-vale-dos-vinhedos.varieties: Reds: Merlot (at least 60%) with Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Tannat; varietal red only as Merlot (85%). Whites: Chardonnay (at least 60%) with Riesling Italico; varietal white only as Chardonnay (85%). Sparkling: at least 60% Chardonnay and/or Pinot Noir, rest Riesling Italico. American varieties and hybrids banned.
br-vale-dos-vinhedos.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 12% potential for reds, 11% for whites; sparkling base grapes at most 11.5% potential. Wines at least 12% (red) and 11% (white). No chaptalisation or must concentration (up to 1% enrichment may be allowed in very wet years).
br-vale-dos-vinhedos.max_yield: 10 t/ha for still wines (2.5 kg per vine for reds, 3.0 kg for whites); 12 t/ha and 4.0 kg per vine for sparkling.
br-vale-dos-vinhedos.ageing: Reds released no earlier than 12 months, whites 6 months, counted from 1 March of the vintage; oak is the only wood allowed. Sparkling: traditional method only, at least 9 months on lees.
br-vale-dos-vinhedos.styles: Dry red, dry white, and white or rose traditional-method sparkling (Nature, Extra-Brut, Brut only).
br-vale-dos-vinhedos.labelling: 100% of grapes from the delimited area (about 72 km2 in Bento Goncalves, Garibaldi and Monte Belo do Sul, land below 400 m excluded); made, aged and bottled inside it. Vertical shoot positioning (espaldeira) only; hand harvest; no irrigation or plastic cover. Every lot passes a blind tasting panel; bottles carry numbered DO seals. Sparkling labels must say "Metodo Tradicional" and may not name varieties or lees time. DO registered by INPI in 2012 (IP since 2002).
